next.reason: 1985: 'S' with no SIGN clause has an operational sign whose position and representation the implementor defines; 'General rules 5 through 7 do not apply'. §2023:13.18.52.4 GR4 says the same ('The implementor shall specify the position and representation of the operational sign'; documented per DOC-A.1-177) and exempts only GR5 and GR6. Not exempting GR7 is inert: its first sentence (the item is signed) agrees with GR4 and its conversion sentence applies only 'If a SIGN clause applies'.
